lines.description: entry of the packing area; boxes travel left to right

rules.text: Every blue box must stay at least 1.5 seconds in the inspection zone before it crosses into packing.
A blue box may only go into packing after it has stopped at the inspection station for at least one second.
No blue box should ever reach packing without passing through inspection first.
After a blue box has been in the inspection zone for one second, it must reach packing within 6 seconds.
Every worker near the conveyor must wear a yellow helmet.
